snippet.title: Dimakerus | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Join the Playtest and Wishlist now:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1911340/Dimakerus

Disguise as anyone. Mimic their ways. Ambush your friends. Discover cursed Roman relics in procedural catacombs and wield their might to obliterate those who stand in your way.

Original Soundtrack by Acepe.
https://www.youtube.com/@meditations.acepe./
